lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance, roughly circular pixel clusters are arranged in quasi-linear horizontal rows starting posterior to the fifth gill slit, with approximately 15-20 distinct units visible in the immediate mid-flank sector.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Three visible vertical bands of increased luminance intersect with the horizontal dot patterns behind the branchial region, forming localized grid-like nodes of maximum intensity.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A linear feature with a high-contrast vertical gradient—characterized by a luminance peak at the dorsal-facing edge and a trough at the ventral-facing edge—extends horizontally from the post-cranial region across the superior margin of the gill slits.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct C-shaped indentation with disrupted spot patterning is situated superior to the first and second gill slits; an irregular dark pixel cluster is visible posterior to the ventral margin of the final gill slit.
other_distinctive_markers: A circular blue-toned graphic overlay is present in the upper right quadrant; alphanumeric white text overlay at the bottom center reads "18/04/04 Paul Waghorn".
